copy.title: good morning my beautiful
paragraphs: I hope you had the best dreams handsome, I spent all night wishing I could wake up to your beautiful face.
Thank you for making me feel so loved, listening to all my nerdy yaps like you're hanging on every single word.
You make me feel more loved than I could ever explain and I only hope I make you feel the same.
Keep me updated with absolutely everything, I love being a part of your life in every single way you let me in.
